name: Jiangui de Daxue Shenghuo
source:
The heroine, who has just stepped into university life, never imagined she would soon find herself in a bizarre yet sweet supernatural experience.

Her dormitory is located in the most remote part of campus. Shortly after the semester begins, a series of paranormal incidents occur in the building, and the heroine is plagued by inexplicable episodes of night hag. As she becomes more deeply entangled in the haunting events, the hidden intentions and true natures of the people around her gradually come to light. With life-and-death crises closing in, the heroine holds the key to solving everything.

Each character has their own unique charm: the gentle and kind neighbor-brother, the attention-seeking idol senior, the shy and quiet gloomy boy, the cheerful and athletic schoolmate, the lively and enthusiastic beautiful roommate… What kind of heroine can captivate them, and who will ultimately win the heroine’s heart?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4656220/Haunted_Uni_Love/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
刚刚踏入大学生活的女主人公，没想到自己很快就陷入了一段离奇而又甜蜜的超自然经历。

她的宿舍位于校园最偏远的地方。学期开始后不久，大楼内发生了一系列超自然事件，女主人公也受到了莫名其妙的夜魔女的困扰。随着她对这些令人难以忘怀的事件的纠缠越来越深，周围人隐藏的意图和真实本性逐渐暴露出来。生死危机逼近，女主角掌握着解决一切问题的钥匙。

每个角色都有着自己独特的魅力：温柔善良的邻家哥哥、引人注目的偶像前辈、害羞安静的阴沉男孩、开朗运动的同学、活泼热情的美女室友……什么样的女主角能迷倒他们，谁最终能赢得女主角的芳心呢？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4656220/Haunted_Uni_Love/]Steam[/url]]
